agent.basis: 15% of electricity: lighting is 25% of 1,877,280 kWh ($72,165) in 645,000 sqft drying/packing/warehouse, LED saves 60% = 281,592 kWh at $0.154/kWh
agent.measure: Retrofit to LED high-bays and strips in raisin/fig tunnel dryer hall, packing and bulk dried-fruit warehouse

agent.basis: 9% of electricity: dryer circulation fans, concentrate evaporator pumps, cooling-tower and dust-collection fans are 30% of kWh ($86,597), VFDs save 30% = 168,955 kWh
agent.measure: Install VFDs on tunnel dehydrator circulation fans, paste evaporator and cooling-tower fans/pumps for raisins/figs drying

agent.basis: 7% of electricity: compressed air for optical sorters, pitters, paste formers and packaging is 20% of kWh ($57,732), 35% lost to leaks = 131,410 kWh saved
agent.measure: Ultrasonic survey and repair compressed-air leaks on sorting, paste-forming pneumatics and packaging lines

agent.basis: 17.5% of natural gas: tunnel dehydrators are 70% of 15,860 MMBtu ($69,639), heat-wheel recovery of 350F exhaust to preheat makeup air saves 25% = 2,776 MMBtu at $6.27/MMBtu
agent.measure: Install air-to-air heat-wheel/plate exchanger to recover tunnel dryer exhaust to preheat dryer makeup air for figs/raisins

agent.basis: 13.5% of natural gas: steam for paste cookers, blanchers and concentrate evaporator is 45% of gas ($44,768), failed traps waste 30% = 2,145 MMBtu saved plus condensate water/sewer
agent.measure: Repair/replace failed steam traps and steam leaks on fig paste kettles, blanchers and concentrate evaporator

agent.basis: 3.75% of electricity: refrigeration/cold storage for paste and concentrate drums is 25% of kWh ($72,165), raising chill-water/suction setpoint and cleaning condensers saves 15% = 70,398 kWh
agent.measure: Raise chilled-water setpoint to highest safe temperature and clean condensers for paste/concentrate cold storage

agent.basis: 8% of natural gas: tune all gas dehydrator burners and paste boiler by flue-gas O2/CO analysis saves 8% of 15,860 MMBtu = 1,269 MMBtu
agent.measure: Analyze flue gas and tune air/fuel ratio on raisin/fig dehydrator burners and paste steam boiler

agent.basis: 10% of water plus water disposal: 10% of ($39,056 + $30,608) by reusing filtered wash/flume water; wash water dominates dried fig/raisin use
agent.measure: Treat with screening/filtration and reuse fig/raisin wash and flume rinse waters for first-wash makeup

agent.basis: 6% of natural gas: bare paste cooker jackets and steam/condensate/hot-water lines lose 6% of 15,860 MMBtu = 952 MMBtu saved
agent.measure: Install/repair insulation on steam, condensate and hot-water lines and paste cooker jackets

agent.basis: 1.5% of electricity cost: low power factor penalty and kVA demand from dryer fans, refrigeration compressors and air compressors; correction saves demand charges
agent.measure: Install automatic capacitor bank to optimize plant power factor to >0.95 and cut kVA demand

agent.basis: 6% of electricity (3.40M kWh @ $0.0215) + 6% of electric demand (7150 kW-months @ $16.25)
agent.measure: Install VFDs on dust/waste collection fans and HVAC humidification supply/return fans serving carding and ring-spinning rooms to match airflow to 8760h production

agent.basis: 4.5% of electricity (2.55M kWh @ $0.0215) + 4.5% of electric demand (5363 kW-months @ $16.25)
agent.measure: Retrofit 361000 sqft spinning, winding, carding rooms and warehouse HID/fluorescent high-bays to LED high-bays with reflectors for yarn inspection levels

agent.basis: 3% of electricity (1.70M kWh @ $0.0215) + 3% of electric demand (3575 kW-months @ $16.25) for compressed-air system
agent.measure: Repair compressed-air leaks on ring-spinning pneumatic tubes, roving creels, vortex spinning feeds, winding splicers and air-jet cleaning guns

agent.basis: 2.5% of electricity (1.42M kWh @ $0.0215) + 2.5% of electric demand (2979 kW-months @ $16.25)
agent.measure: Replace failed standard motors on cards, draw frames, rovers, ring-spinning frames and winders with NEMA Premium motors on repair/replace policy

agent.basis: 2% of electricity (1.13M kWh @ $0.0215) + 2% of electric demand (2383 kW-months @ $16.25) for compressed-air system
agent.measure: Upgrade rotary-screw compressor controls with sequencer and VSD trim compressor to follow spinning-mill air-jet and pneumatic load

agent.basis: 1.5% of electricity (0.85M kWh @ $0.0215) + 1.5% of electric demand (1788 kW-months @ $16.25) for compressed-air system
agent.measure: Lower spinning air header from ~100 to 85 psig and add regulators/flow controllers at winding, card waste and cleaning stations

agent.basis: 1.2% of total electric bill in PF penalties and I2R losses from ~9931 kW avg induction load on spinning frames
agent.measure: Install automatic capacitor banks to correct power factor of large induction motor load on ring-spinning frames and HVAC fans

agent.basis: 1.6% of electric demand (1920 kW-months @ $16.25) with minimal kWh change by shaving peak
agent.measure: Install demand controller to stagger startup of spinning frames, bale press and waste collectors to shave 160 kW spinning peak

agent.basis: 0.8% of electricity (0.45M kWh @ $0.0215) + 0.8% of electric demand (953 kW-months @ $16.25)
agent.measure: Replace standard V-belts with cogged/synchronous belts on spinning-frame tangential drives, HVAC and card waste fans

agent.basis: 0.6% of electricity (0.34M kWh @ $0.0215) + 0.6% of electric demand (715 kW-months @ $16.25) for HVAC/humidification
agent.measure: Reduce outside make-up air and optimize temperature/humidity controls to minimum 55% RH needed for spun-yarn strength in spinning rooms
